context_for_next_testing_agent: TiltCard component applies 3D parallax tilt effect using CSS transform with perspective(800px) rotateX() rotateY() scale3d(). On mouse hover, the card tilts based on mouse position within the card. On mouse leave, transform resets to 0deg rotation. Glare overlay uses radial-gradient that follows mouse position. Cards use data-testid attributes: 'orange-pharmacy-card', 'orange-healthplus-card', 'labs-card-mango', 'labs-card-proton', 'labs-card-nexugene'. All cards have inline style borderRadius: '2rem' (32px).
